assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) for the normal period is calculated as 50% Project grade (P) + 50% Laboratory grade (L). For approval, L must be >= 9.5 and P must be >= 9.5. The laboratory grade L is the average of the 6 best out of 7 programming exercises. The project grade P is calculated by P = min{TP, EP} + abs(TP - EP)*max{15, TP + 5}/100, where EP = 50% P1 + 50% P2, and TP is the practical test. An optional resit exam (E) can substitute the laboratory component (L), leading to NF = 50% P + 50% max{L, E}, where the exam grade must be >= 8 for approval. For the special period, NF = 50% P + 50% E. The final grade must be >= 9.5 for approval.
bibliography: Martins J.P., Programação em Python. Introdução à Programação Utilizando Múltiplos Paradigmas, IST Press, 5ª Edição, 2023 (main)
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LERC Eng. de Telecomunicações e Informática (IST)
